body: @elastic/es-core-infra would it be okay to assign this to you? Instead of just labelling everything with `:Search/Mapping` that relates to mappings, we're trying to consider the underlying issue and determine who'd be best to handle it. As the experts on date formats, it seems like you'd understand the best default, and if any changes need to be made to the formats themselves.
